method: Passive recorded-state and action accounting plus isolated calls to the immutable submitted policy for source matching and route/forecast diagnostics. No game engine, simulated episode or counterfactual continuation.
limits: Two selected losses do not establish a controlled win-rate comparison against Cycle 15.
Reversal pairs overlap and are not a count of disjoint wasted two-action trips.
Net product receipts are the cash residual after confirmed fixed purchases and hires, not independent gross sale totals.
Night harvest adjustments are separated in each player record. Opponent newborn weed events require seed accounting and are listed separately from visible crop retirements.
Due-but-unfinished care uses the current policy care eligibility rule, not an optimal-care proof.

cohort_forecast_check.interpretation: Compare the existing analytic full-care production estimate with observed cohort harvests; no counterfactual game. Both exclude initial shed/carries. No new animals are installed after this observation and terminal animal-held yield is zero.
